source: RoboTwin 0aeea2d: description/task_instruction/<task>.json full_description and envs/<task>.py check_success, restated (x, y, z in the world frame; left = negative x; 'open' = opening above 0.8, 'closed' = below 0.2)

notes.adjust_bottle: A bottle lies on its side; pick it up with the arm on its side of the table and hold it upright, head up. Success: the bottle's head above z 0.90 and beyond x -0.15 (left arm) or +0.15 (right arm). No gripper condition: keep holding it.
notes.beat_block_hammer: Grasp the hammer and strike the block with the hammer's head. Success: the head within 2 cm of the block in x and y and touching it. No gripper condition.
notes.blocks_ranking_rgb: Line up the red, green and blue blocks from left to right in that order. Success: x of red < green < blue, neighbours within 13 cm in x and 3 cm in y, both grippers open.
notes.blocks_ranking_size: Move the three blocks (random colours, three sizes) to the table centre in a row from largest on the left to smallest on the right. Success: x of largest < middle < smallest, neighbours within 13 cm in x and 3 cm in y, both grippers open.
notes.click_alarmclock: Press the button on top of the alarm clock. Success: with the gripper of the arm on the clock's side closed, a finger touches within 3 cm of the button's centre; it counts once reached.
notes.click_bell: Press the top centre of the bell. Success: with the gripper of the arm on the bell's side closed, a finger touches within 2.5 cm (x, y) and 3 cm (z) of the bell's top centre; it counts once reached.
notes.dump_bin_bigbin: Pick up the small bin and pour its balls into the big dustbin on the floor left of the table (x about -0.45). Success: the small bin held above z 1.0 while every ball is inside the dustbin (z 0.13-0.25). No gripper condition.
notes.grab_roller: Grasp the roller with both arms and lift it. Success: both grippers closed and the roller above z 0.80.
notes.handover_block: Grasp the red block with the left arm, hand it to the right arm and place it on the blue pad. Success: the block within 3 cm (x, y) and 1 cm (z) of the pad's target point, right gripper open.
notes.handover_mic: Grasp the microphone with the arm on its side and hand it to the other arm. Success: the receiving gripper closed on the microphone, the giving gripper open, the microphone above z 0.92 and on the receiver's side of x = 0.
notes.hanging_mug: Left arm: pick up the mug, turn it and set it down mid-table; right arm: pick it up again and hang it on the rack by its handle. Success: the handle within 2 cm (x, y) of the rack's hanging point and above z 0.86, right gripper open.
notes.lift_pot: Lift the pot with both arms, one at each handle. Success: the pot above z 0.82 and upright, each arm's grasp centre within 3 cm of its handle.
notes.move_can_pot: Pick up the can with the arm on its side and set it upright on the table beside the pot, on that arm's side of it. Success: the can at smaller x than the pot (left arm) or larger (right arm), less than 20 cm from it in x and within 3.5 cm in y, upright and resting on the table, both grippers open.
notes.move_pillbottle_pad: Pick up the pill bottle and place it on the pad. Success: the bottle within 3 cm (x, y) of the pad, standing at table height (within 5 mm), both grippers open.
notes.move_playingcard_away: Pick up the playing card and move it further out on the side of the table it lies on. Success: the card beyond 23 cm from the table's centre line in x (|x| > 0.23), both grippers open.
notes.move_stapler_pad: Move the stapler onto the coloured mat with the appropriate arm. Success: within 2 cm (x, y) and 1 cm (z) of the mat, aligned with it, both grippers open.
notes.open_laptop: Open the laptop lid with one arm. Success: the lid at least 40% of the way through its hinge range while the opening arm's grasp centre stays within 10 cm of the lid's grasp point (RoboTwin fixes which arm from the laptop's yaw). No gripper condition.
notes.open_microwave: Open the microwave door with one arm. Success: the door at least 60% of the way through its range. No gripper condition.
notes.pick_diverse_bottles: Pick up one bottle with each arm and hold them up in front of the robot. Success: each bottle's top above z 0.89 and within 10 cm (x, y) of its arm's target, left about (-0.06, -0.105) and right about (0.06, -0.105). No gripper condition: keep holding.
notes.pick_dual_bottles: Pick up one bottle with each arm and hold them up in front of the robot. Success: each bottle's top above z 0.89 and within 10 cm (x, y) of its arm's target, left about (-0.06, -0.105) and right about (0.06, -0.105). No gripper condition: keep holding.
notes.place_a2b_left: Place object A to the left of object B with the appropriate arm. Success: A 8-20 cm from B in (x, y), at smaller x, within 5 cm of B in y, both grippers open.
notes.place_a2b_right: Place object A to the right of object B with the appropriate arm. Success: A 8-20 cm from B in (x, y), at larger x, within 5 cm of B in y, both grippers open.
notes.place_bread_basket: Put the bread into the basket; with two breads, both arms each take one at the same time. Success: every bread within 5 cm (x, y) of the basket and above the table, both grippers open.
notes.place_bread_skillet: One arm lifts the skillet by its handle while the other puts the bread into it. Success: the bread within 3.5 cm (x, y) of the skillet's centre, skillet and bread both above z 0.76 (table offset included). No gripper condition.
notes.place_burger_fries: Put the hamburger and the fries onto the tray with both arms. Success: each within 8 cm (x, y) of its spot on the tray, both grippers open.
notes.place_can_basket: Put the can into the basket with one arm, then lift the basket with the other. Success: the can in the basket (touching it, not the table), can and basket both more than 2 cm above their start heights, the basket upright. No gripper condition.
notes.place_cans_plasticbox: Put both cans into the plastic box with both arms. Success: each can within 4 cm (x, y) of one of the box's two slots, both grippers open.
notes.place_container_plate: Place the container onto the plate. Success: within 5 cm (x, y) and 3 cm (z) of the plate, both grippers open.
notes.place_dual_shoes: Put both shoes into the shoebox side by side, one arm per shoe, tips pointing left. Success: the shoes at about (0, -0.17) and (0, -0.09), each within 5 cm, tips left within a small tolerance, resting in the box, both grippers open.
notes.place_empty_cup: Place the empty cup on the coaster. Success: within 3.5 cm (x, y) and 1.5 cm (z) of the coaster's centre, both grippers open.
notes.place_fan: Place the fan on the coloured mat, facing the robot. Success: within 4 cm of the mat target, facing the robot within a small tolerance, both grippers open.
notes.place_mouse_pad: Place the mouse on the coloured mat, aligned with it. Success: within 1.5 cm (x) and 1.2 cm (y) of the mat's centre, axis-aligned, both grippers open.
notes.place_object_basket: Put the object into the basket with one arm, then grasp the basket with the other and move it slightly away. Success: the object in the basket (touching it, not the table), object and basket both more than 2 cm above their start heights, the basket upright. No gripper condition.
notes.place_object_scale: Put the object on the scale with the arm on its side. Success: within 3.5 cm (x, y) of the scale's centre and resting on it, that arm's gripper open.
notes.place_object_stand: Place the object on the display stand with the appropriate arm. Success: within 3 cm (x, y) of the stand, both grippers open.
notes.place_phone_stand: Put the phone on the phone stand. Success: the phone within 4.5 cm (x) and 4 cm (y, z) of its place on the stand, both grippers open.
notes.place_shoe: Place the shoe on the mat with its tip pointing left. Success: the shoe within 5 cm (x) and 2 cm (y) of (0, -0.08), tip left within a small tolerance, both grippers open.
notes.press_stapler: Press the stapler down with one arm. Success: a finger touches within 3 cm of the stapler's press point on top; it counts once reached.
notes.put_bottles_dustbin: Put every bottle into the dustbin on the floor left of the table (x about -0.45). Success: every bottle inside it (within 22 cm in x and 33 cm in y of (-0.45, 0), z 0.2-0.7). No gripper condition.
notes.put_object_cabinet: Open the cabinet's drawer with one arm and put the object into it with the arm on the object's side. Success: the object within 5 cm (x, y) of the drawer's target point and 0.7 to 12 cm above its start height, the object arm's gripper open.
notes.rotate_qrcode: Pick up the QR-code board, turn it so the code faces the robot and set it down. Success: the code facing the robot within a small tolerance, the board back at table height (z below 0.75, table offset included), both grippers open.
notes.scan_object: Pick up the scanner with one arm and the object with the other, and hold the object in front of the scanner's head. Success: the object 0-7 cm along the scanning direction and within 2.5 cm of it, both grippers closed (holding both).
notes.shake_bottle: Pick up the bottle with the proper arm and shake it. Success: the bottle above z 0.80 (table offset included); the check needs only the lift, so the episode ends as soon as it holds.
notes.shake_bottle_horizontally: Pick up the bottle with the proper arm and shake it horizontally. Success: the bottle above z 0.80 (table offset included); the check needs only the lift, so the episode ends as soon as it holds.
notes.stack_blocks_three: Move the red, green and blue blocks to the table centre; stack green on red and blue on green. Success: each upper block 5 cm above the one below (within 1.2 cm) and within 2.5 cm in x and y, both grippers open.
notes.stack_blocks_two: Move the red and green blocks to the table centre and stack green on red. Success: green 5 cm above red (within 1.2 cm) and within 2.5 cm in x and y, both grippers open.
notes.stack_bowls_three: Stack the three bowls into one another. Success: the bowls within 4 cm of each other in x and y, bottom to top no higher than 2 cm above z 0.74, 0.77 and 0.81 (table offset included), both grippers open.
notes.stack_bowls_two: Stack the two bowls into one another. Success: within 4 cm of each other in x and y, bottom and top no higher than 2 cm above z 0.74 and 0.77 (table offset included), both grippers open.
notes.stamp_seal: Grasp the stamp and press it onto the mat of the named colour. Success: the stamp within 1 cm (x, y) of that mat, both grippers open.
notes.turn_switch: Flip the switch with one arm. Success: the switch turned to its end position (within 0.05 of its joint limit). No gripper condition.
